name: PancakeBunny
fix_description: In valueOfAsset, LP token valuation uses IPancakePair.getReserves() which returns instantaneous reserves manipulable via flash loans. Fix: use a TWAP-based oracle for reserve values, or use the fair LP pricing formula that calculates LP value from individual token prices obtained from a manipulation-resistant oracle (e.g., Chainlink) rather than from pool reserves directly.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-idea exploit that abuses a reflection token’s deliver() mechanic to alter the pair balance, then directly profits via pair.swap. It requires minimal protocol-specific setup, no flash loan orchestration, and the PoC is well under 100 lines with essentially one core interaction pattern.
